ok so I finally tried making sourdough this weekend and wow, it did not go how the videos said it would. The starter was fine, bubbly, smelled like feet in a good way. Then I mixed everything Saturday morning and just... forgot about it? My sister called, we talked for like two hours about her landlord, and by the time I remembered the dough it had basically taken over the bowl. Poked it. It sighed at me.

I baked it anyway because what else are you gonna do. Dutch oven, 450, lid on for twenty then off. Came out flat as a frisbee but with this weirdly great crust, dark and blistered, and the inside was dense but not gummy. Ate half of it standing at the counter with too much butter.

Would I call it a success? No. Was it the best thing I ate all week? Also kind of yes. Next time I'm setting three alarms and maybe not answering the phone. Dad says his mother never measured anything and hers always worked, which is not helpful information, Dad.
